dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature (falcate) from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex with a narrow pixel radius, forming a sharp morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of approximately 1.4:1 measured as maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, high-radius convexity defining the anterior cranial boundary above the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the anterior melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Pronounced obtuse angle visible at the pixel coordinates where the melon curvature transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible dark, irregular punctate marks along the mid-lateral flank and faint linear markings near the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly visible blowhole on the superior cranial surface; distinct pectoral fin visible on the lower anterior flank.
